input.content:
Biogas plant BGA3 processes mainly slurry and solid substrate. Two solid dosing units (Dos 1 and Dos 2) each feed 50 tonnes of substrate per day directly into digesters F1 and F2 respectively. Two slurry pre-pits (each 5×8 metres) pump 20 cubic metres of slurry per day into digesters F1 and F2.

Digesters F1 and F2 each have a diameter of 26 metres and a wall height of 6 metres, each equipped with three paddle agitators. Each digester carries a dome roof that also serves as an integrated gas storage; the total gas space (dome plus unfilled headspace) is 719 cubic metres. The digesters operate mesophilically at 40 degrees Celsius (313.15 K) with a fill level of 90 percent. Digestate from F1 and F2 flows into post-digester N1, which also measures 26 metres in diameter and 6 metres in height and is fitted with one paddle agitator and one long-axis agitator. N1 also has a dome roof with a total gas space of 719 cubic metres and operates at 40 degrees Celsius with a fill level of 90 percent. From the post-digester the digestate moves into digestate store G1 with a diameter of 28 metres and a height of 6 metres, equipped with two submersible agitators. The digestate store is unheated (approx. 20 degrees Celsius / 293.15 K), has a fill level of 90 percent and a total gas space of 799 cubic metres.

The biogas produced is fed to a combined heat and power unit (CHP) with a rated electrical output of 500 kW. The CHP achieves an electrical efficiency of 40 percent and a thermal efficiency of 45 percent. An emergency flare is available for fault conditions. A condensate shaft is connected to digester F1.

Substrate feed: 50 t/d maize silage each via the dosing units (Dos1 into F1, Dos2 into F2) and 20 m³/d cattle slurry each from two pre-pits (into F1 and F2).
